formal_statement: ∀ (x1 x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x1 →     PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x2 →       (∀ (x5 : Fin (9 : ℕ) → Bool),           have x6 : List Bool := x1.wires (List.ofFn x5 ++ [x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ))]);           x2.eval (x6 ++ [!x6.getD x1.output Bool.false]) = (x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (4 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (0 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (1 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (2 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (3 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (7 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (6 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) || x5 (8 : Fin (9 : ℕ)) && x5 (5 : Fin (9 : ℕ)))) →         (14 : ℕ) ≤ x1.size + x2.size
plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Take the nine inputs and the wire OR(x_0, x_4), a circuit A of AND and OR gates (at most two inputs a gate) on them, then the negation of A's output as one more wire, then a circuit B of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates on all those wires. If B computes the function, A and B together have at least 14 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_4) computes its edge function
